 Jordyn Woods debuts new version of lucky Knicks bag at home opener 
 By 
 Antoinette Bueno 
 Published 
 Oct. 20, 2026, 9:27 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Jordyn Woods just debuted another game-winning bag .
 The model, 29, brought out a new limited edition colorway of her now iconic Woods by Jordyn Tux Clutch Mini bag during the New York Knicks’ season opener against the Philadelphia 76ers on Tuesday at Madison Square Garden.
 Woods debuted the bag in the color Trophy Gold — a fitting name given the Knicks’ NBA championship win in June.

 Fans will remember her lucky bag last season was in the color Summer Citrus.
 Woods was sitting court-side Tuesday supporting her husband, Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns, looking chic in a suede outfit and strappy gold heels. She was of course asked where her lucky orange bag was .
 “It’s in retirement,” she joked with a big smile. “But we have a new one, this is for the trophy.”
 Towns, 30, also happily posed with the bag, continuing their ritual from last season.
 6 
 Woods and her husband, Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns, continued their tradition from last season as she passed him the bag to hold.

 The ostrich clutch from Woods’ own brand retails for $155, and also comes in the colors black, blue, snake, and off-white crocodile.
 The influencer’s bright orange version of the bag became her good-luck purse throughout the Knicks’ postseason winning streak, after the team’s only loss occurred when she left it at home due to Game 3’s no-bag policy.
 “It’s gotten to the point where if people don’t see me carrying it during a close game, they start blaming me for changing the routine,” she told Vogue in May.
 Towns was also a big believer in the bag, memorably declaring after the Knicks’ Game 5 win, “The bag did its thang tonight! I ain’t gon’ lie to you. We gotta put this in like the Whitney or the Guggenheim.”
 6 
 The bag is from Woods’ own line, Woody by Jordyn. Getty Images 
 6 
 It retails for $155. Getty Images 
 The bag did indeed go on display at the Guggenheim after the Knicks’ historic win this summer.
 Woods said in a press release, “The Guggenheim is one of my favorite places, and I never imagined that something I designed would one day be on view at the museum.”
 The couple got married in August in a star-studded ceremony in Malibu, California. 
 Guests included Kylie Jenner and boyfriend Timothée Chalamet, Justin Bieber and wife Hailey Bieber, Jada Pinkett Smith, Teyana Taylor, Gayle King, Michael B. Jordan, Ben Stiller and Christine Taylor.
